user.title: Connect your Aladdin Connect account
user.description: Sign in with the account used in the Genie Aladdin Connect app. Door control uses the Genie cloud and requires internet access.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Aladdin Connect
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current password for this account.

reconfigure.title: Update account password
reconfigure.description: Enter the new password for the existing Aladdin Connect account. To use another account, add a separate integration entry.

error.invalid_auth: The email address or password was rejected.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Genie service, or the cloud API returned an unexpected response. Try again later.
error.auth_challenge: This account requires an additional sign-in step. Complete it in the Aladdin Connect app, then try again. Ongoing MFA challenges are not supported.
error.no_doors: No garage doors were found. Add a door in the Aladdin Connect app first.

data.show_shared: Show doors shared with this account

data_description.scan_interval: While a door is moving, or after a command, the integration polls every 5 seconds until it settles or 90 seconds elapse.
data_description.show_shared: The Genie service must grant permission to control shared doors.
data_description.ignored_doors: Select doors or enter their cloud door IDs, such as F0AD4E1BC74D_1.
